KarteaPhaseCsvDAO

class KarteaPhaseCsvDAO[source]

Bases: ReadOnlyDAO

Read-only DAO of KarteaPhase, read from the phase CSV files.

Each phase is a CSV file ({phase}.csv) with one row per level. The file in the user’s data folder takes priority over the built-in resource (see KarteaPathConfig.read_phase_data). This is the only place that reads these CSV files: KarteaPhaseLevelCsvDAO queries the levels through it.

Attributes:
csv_handlerCSVHandler

Utility for reading CSV content.

Methods

list_phase_ids() -> list[int]

Ids of the existing phases (user folder + built-in resources).

load_phase_from_csv(kartea_phase_id) -> KarteaPhase | None

Read the phase and its levels (each level points to the phase).

select(obj_id) -> KarteaPhase | None

Phase by id, with its levels.

list() -> list[KarteaPhase]

All phases, ordered by id, with their levels.

Notes

Creating the DAO ensures the KarTEA folders exist. Phases are not cached: every call reads the CSV again.

static list_phase_ids()[source]

Return the ids of the existing phases.

Returns:
list[int]

Sorted ids, without duplicates, from the CSV files of the user’s phases folder and of the :/phases Qt resource.

Notes

Only files whose name (without .csv) is a number count.

load_phase_from_csv(kartea_phase_id)[source]

Read a phase and its levels.

Parameters:
kartea_phase_idint

Id of the phase (name of its CSV file).

Returns:
KarteaPhase | None

The phase with level_list filled, or None if the file does not exist, is empty or has no valid level.

Notes

  • Rows whose phase column differs from kartea_phase_id are skipped, as are rows without an id.

  • obj_type is parsed from space-separated numbers; non-numeric tokens are ignored.

  • Columns annotated as int or float in KarteaPhaseLevel are converted; the others keep the text.
